lines: table.write([batch.clone()]).await; // Delta lead, caller policy still unknown.
note:
Delta commits are idempotent only when the writer supplies an application transaction id.
Without one there is nothing in the log that says "this batch was already written", so a
scheduler that retries a write whose result it never saw appends the same rows twice --
and the table is then wrong in a way no later read can detect.
See content/topics/transactions.md.

Precision note: this matches syntax, not types. `RecordBatchWriter::write` also matches, and
that call only stages data -- it commits separately through `flush_and_commit`, which is
where its commit properties belong. Treat a match as a question about where the commit
happens, not as a finding that one is misconfigured.
message: A write is awaited with no commit properties; a retry can duplicate the data.
